offers_products.reason: Regulated natural gas distribution is a utility delivery service, not a manufactured or software product.

offers_services.reason: Natural gas distribution utility service through Kansas Gas Service, Oklahoma Natural Gas and Texas Gas Service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Serves residential customers, about 2.3 million customers across Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Also serves commercial, industrial, transportation and wholesale customers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly utility gas service billed to the same customers on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home heating and essential gas utility service is hard to cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly gas bills.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on pipelines and distribution mains, which are network assets rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly residential and small commercial households, with some industrial and wholesale.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates about 45,000 miles of distribution mains and pipelines that need continuous capital investment.
